lines.beaver: 안녕하십니까? 오늘 어떤 선수를 소개해 주시겠습니까?
lines.beaver_en: Hello. Which athlete will you introduce today?
lines.beaver_roman: annyeonghasimnikka? oneul eotteon seonsureul sogaehae jusigetseumnikka?
lines.learner: 네, 우리 팀원 박서준 선수를 소개할게요.
lines.en: Yes, I'll introduce our team member, Park Seojun.
lines.roman: ne, uri timwon Bak Seojun seonsureul sogaehalgeyo.

lines.beaver_en: What event does Park Seojun compete in?
lines.beaver_roman: Bak Seojun seonsuneun eotteon jongmok seonsuimnikka?
lines.learner: 활을 쏘는 양궁 선수예요. 이번 대회에 출전했어요.
lines.en: He's an archer who shoots a bow. He entered this competition.
lines.roman: hwareul ssoneun yanggung seonsuyeyo. ibeon daehoee chuljeonhaesseoyo.

lines.beaver_en: Does he do other events too?
lines.learner: 네, 육상과 무술도 하는 등 운동에 재능을 발휘해요.
lines.en: Yes, he also does track and martial arts, showing talent in sports.
lines.roman: ne, yuksanggwa musuldo haneun deung undonge jaeneungeul balhwihaeyo.

lines.beaver_en: Was he good from the start?
lines.en: No, at first he was last. He was often eliminated.
He practiced daily with teammates, so now he's number one.

lines.learner: 결승전 참가자가 모두 강해서 쉽지 않아요.
lines.en: All the finalists are strong, so it's not easy.
lines.roman: gyeolseungjeon chamgajaga modu ganghaeseo swipji anayo.

lines.beaver_en: Has he lost in past matches?
lines.learner: 네, 작년 결승전에서 한 점 차이로 패했어요.
lines.en: Yes, he lost last year's final by one point.
lines.roman: ne, jangnyeon gyeolseungjeoneseo han jeom chairo paehaesseoyo.

lines.learner: 슬펐지만 그 덕분에 더 열심히 했어요.
lines.en: He was sad, but thanks to that he worked harder.
lines.roman: seulpeotjiman geu deokbune deo yeolsimhi haesseoyo.

lines.beaver_en: Is there anything you'd like to say last?
lines.learner: 관중이 응원해 주면 더 잘한다고 해요.
lines.en: He says he does better when the crowd cheers.
lines.roman: gwanjungi eungwonhae jumyeon deo jalhandago haeyo.

lines.beaver_en: Thanks for the great introduction. We'll cheer at the final.
lines.en: Thank you. Please cheer for him a lot!
